top_signals.title: China Cancels Some Fuel Shipments to Support Domestic Supply
top_signals.summary: Chinese fuel exporters have canceled some oil-product cargoes slated for export in October, as Asia’s top consumer prioritizes domestic supply during an extended period of upheaval in global energy markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Benchmark Yield Hits Highest Since 2002 as Bonds Sell Off
top_signals.summary: The US benchmark yield climbed to the highest since 2002 as rising oil prices drove a renewed selloff in global bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Poetry, history and performance entwine in Daisydoze’s immersive spectacle
top_signals.summary: Since 2018, Daisydoze has been creating site-specific theater productions that explore local history and memory like "Cat Town," now showing in Shimokitazawa.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
